moments.author: Dario Amodei
moments.quote: We must slow the pace at which we improve AI capabilities to avoid potentially devastating consequences in months.
moments.why: A major AI leader calling for a slowdown in development—and quickly gaining endorsement from rivals—hits deep in tech‑savvy circles.

moments.author: Elon Musk
moments.why: When Elon Musk echoes the call for slowing AI, it turns nervous tech chatter into front‑page conversation.

moments.author: Sam Altman
moments.quote: OpenAI will commit to one of Amodei’s safety proposals and will have more to share soon.
moments.why: Altman’s backing from OpenAI solidifies an unusual consensus among AI giants—and social buzz followed.

moments.author: Frank X. Shaw
moments.quote: "It is time for me to move on and try new things."
moments.why: Microsoft’s longtime comms chief announcing his departure struck a chord—guys follow leadership shifts like these.
